column1: # Shared parser test corpus for fileseq (Python), gofileseq (Go) and gofileseq/cpp.
# Keep this file identical in every repository, alongside fileseq.g4.
#   ports kind input directory basename frame_range padding extension
# ports is "all", or a comma-separated list of go, cpp and py.
# kind is seq, single, plain or error. An error line has only ports, kind and input.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
